response.why: batch: player A starts
3 lands with 4 castable 1-drop threats (2x Jackal Pup, Kird Ape, Brute Force for pump). Solid aggressive start: turn 1 Mountain, turn 2 creature pressure.
Play my first Mountain. Need lands to cast threats, and land drop before casting is standard sequence. Will cast a Jackal Pup or Kird Ape next with the red mana.
Cast Jackal Pup. It's a 2/1 for {R}, the most efficient threat I can play turn 1. The self-damage rider is acceptable in aggressive racing.
Pass through upkeep. No upkeep triggers matter here. Need to draw my card and reach main phase to continue developing threats.
Pass through draw. Move to precombat main to play lands and develop threats. No reason to hold priority in draw step.
Play my second Mountain. Land before creatures — land drop is the highest priority in my main phase. Then I'll develop threats.
Cast Jackal Pup. Need to maximize creature count for pressure. I have 2 red mana available (2 untapped Mountains). This uses 1 mana, leaving 1 to cast Kird Ape after.

Pass priority. I've deployed 1 Jackal Pup with my limited red mana. Moving to combat to attack with my 2/1 and force the opponent's decision on blocks. No more efficient plays available with 1 remaining red mana before combat.

Pass to combat. I have 2 Jackal Pups on board; the first can attack, the second is summoning sick. Casting Kird Ape now would waste mana on a creature that can't attack this turn. Better to attack with my 2/1 and apply pressure.
Pass through Begin Combat. No instants to cast now. Moving to declare attackers where I'll send my non-summoning-sick Jackal Pup (2/1) into the red zone.

attack-none (25): Passive play loses races for aggro. Opponent stabilizes with 7-card hand and Dimir removal suite (Cut Down, Go for the Throat). Staying at 20-20 gives them time to deploy blockers/removal. attack-all (75): Correct line—unblocked 2 damage, clock to 18. I maintain tempo with 2 untapped Pups; opponent has no blockers/creatures yet. Racing fast against their slow control-style deck with removal-heavy hand. Pressure is critical.

Pass. I declared attackers (1 Jackal Pup dealt 2 unblocked). Moving to opponent's declare blockers step. I'll hold Brute Force as a combat trick if they declare blockers — cast it AFTER I see their block assignment to maximize value.
Pass. Opponent has no creatures to block with. No blockers will be declared. Moving to combat damage where my 2 damage resolves.
Pass. Combat damage resolved (2 unblocked to opponent). Moving to end combat phase. Opponent now at 18 life. Next is postcombat main where I'll assess my options before ending turn.
Pass through end combat. No tricks needed. Moving to postcombat main phase to develop board or pass turn.
Cast Kird Ape. Use my remaining red mana to deploy another threat. Opponent still has no board. Next turn I'll untap and have 3 creatures (including no longer-sick Jackal Pup) to attack with.

Pass upkeep. Moving to draw step. Opponent has 2 Forests now (gaining mana), but still no creatures visible. I have 5 untapped lands and 3 creatures ready to attack next turn. Will assess draw before combat.

Pass draw. Moving to precombat main phase. I have 3 creatures ready to attack, and the opponent still has no visible threats. Will evaluate attacking for lethal damage or playing Bonebreaker Giant for board presence.

Play Mountain. Always play the land first per tip #9. This gives me 3 untapped lands. Then I'll use my mana to cast Lightning Bolt to the face in my next priority window (3 damage to finish setting up lethal race). Opponent at 18 life — need to race before they stabilize.

Cast Lightning Bolt to the face. 3 damage guaranteed, reduces opponent to 15 life. Sets up lethal race: attack for ~5 damage next turn → 10 life. Another ~5 damage → 5 life. Final attack or burn finishes. Burning now instead of holding is correct when ahead on the clock and opponent has no creatures.

Target opponent (player B). Lightning Bolt to the face deals 3 guaranteed damage, reducing them from 18 to 15 life. Maximizes damage toward lethal, continues the race. Never waste burn on my own creatures when facing is available.

Pass to combat. Opponent at 15 life from Lightning Bolt. I have 2 Jackal Pups (2/1 each) + 1 Kird Ape (1/1) = 5 damage potential unblocked. Plan: attack all in. If opponent blocks, I have Brute Force as a combat trick. If unblocked, that's 5 damage → 10 life remaining.
Pass. Move to combat phase. Ready to declare attackers with all 3 creatures (2+2+1 = 5 damage potential). Opponent at 15 life with no blockers visible yet.
Pass begin combat. Moving to declare attackers. Will send all 3 creatures (both 2/1 Jackal Pups + 1/1 Kird Ape) into the red zone for 5 damage. Opponent at 15 life with no visible blockers.

attack-all (88): Critical! 5 unblocked damage → opp to 10 life. Two more unblocked turns = lethal. Opp has no blockers/creatures; all-in is correct tempo. attack-none (15): Passive, lose the race. hold-variants (50-60): Conservative but slow — every turn held is time for opponent to stabilize. As aggro, I race best by maximizing damage now.

Pass. Declared all 3 attackers (5 unblocked damage → opp to 10). Moving to opponent's declare blockers phase. They have no creatures visible, so likely unblocked. Will continue lethal clock after combat damage resolves.
Pass blockers. Opponent has no creatures, so attacks are unblocked. 5 damage resolves → opponent to 10 life. I'm 2 turns away from lethal.
Pass. Combat damage resolves unblocked: 5 damage to opponent (10→5 life). Next turn: attack for 5 again = lethal. No tricks needed here.
Opponent's turn 6 upkeep. Nothing to do. I'll win next turn attacking for 5 damage at 5 life.

Pass opponent's main phase. They just cast Nessian Courser (3/3, summoning sick) — can't attack yet. Archetype shifted to Mono-Green Stompy. I win next turn if I can push through lethal damage past their blocker.

Cast Brute Force on a Jackal Pup (2/1 → 5/2). Then attack with all three creatures. Opponent's 3/3 Courser can only block one; either way I deal 3+ damage and kill the blocker. Opponent goes to 4-7 life, lethal next turn.
Boost the first Jackal Pup (2/1 → 5/2). The 5 power output is maximum for lethal push when combined with other attackers.

Brute Force resolved. Pass to combat phase. Declare all three creatures as attackers: boosted Jackal Pup (5/2), unboosted Jackal Pup (2/1), Kird Ape (1/1) = 8 power total, opponent's 3/3 Courser can block only one.
Pass to combat. Declare all three creatures attacking: boosted Jackal Pup (5/4), Jackal Pup (2/1), Kird Ape (1/1). Opponent's Courser blocks one; I deal 6+ damage regardless. Lethal imminent.
Pass Begin Combat. Move to Declare Attackers where I'll attack with all three creatures.

Attack-all dominates. Leaves 1-3 put opp at 3-7 life (lethal imminent). Hold strategies branch to opp at 5-9 life, worse risk/reward. Leaf 3 (95): opp at 3, lethal next turn. Leaf 12 (94): also opp at 3. Leaf 1 (85): opp at 4. Worst attack-all (leaf 2, 75) beats most holds. No attack (leaf 0, 5) is indefensible.
Declare attackers complete. All three creatures attacking (Jackal Pup 5/4, Jackal Pup 2/1, Kird Ape 1/1). Pass to Declare Blockers.
Declare Blockers phase. Opponent makes their blocks. Pass priority to allow Combat Damage to resolve.
Combat damage resolved: I dealt 3+ damage (Courser died blocking), opponent at 7 life. Next turn, attack again for lethal. Pass to end of turn.
Courser blocked and dealt 3 damage (I'm at 17), but died in combat. Opponent at 7 life. I'm 2 untapped creatures away from lethal next turn. Pass to end of turn.
End Combat. Pass to end of turn steps. Creatures will untap next turn and I'll win with the final 8 damage attack.
Postcombat Main. No plays needed. Opponent at 7 life, I'll deal 8 damage next turn for lethal. Pass to end of turn.
End Turn. My turn ends, opponent's turn 8 begins. My creatures untap, I attack for 8 damage (2+5+1), bringing opponent from 7 to -1 life. Victory.
Opponent's turn 8 upkeep. They're at 7 life with no board. Pass to their main phase. I'll win in 2 more attacks (5 damage turn 8, 5 damage turn 9 for lethal).
Opponent draws. Hand 6→7. Pass to their main phase. Lethal in 2 attacks coming.
Opponent's precombat main, 7 life, no board. They played a 4th Forest (all tapped). No threat. Pass to their combat phase.
Opponent cast Rumbling Baloth (4/4, summoning sick). Changes nothing - I still win in 2 attacks (blocks one creature, I deal 3 unblocked turn 8, 5 unblocked turn 9). Pass to their combat phase.
Begin Combat. Rumbling Baloth has summoning sickness, can't attack. Pass through their combat.
Declare Attackers. Opponent can't attack (Baloth has summoning sickness). Pass to blockers phase, then back to my turn 8. I attack for lethal in 2 turns.
End Combat. No damage dealt. Pass through opponent's end of turn to my turn 8. Attack for 5 damage, leaving opponent at 2 life. Lethal next turn.
Opponent's postcombat main, nothing to cast. Pass to end of turn, then my turn 8. Attack for 5 unblocked damage → 2 life. Lethal next turn.
End opponent's turn 8. My turn 8 coming up - attack with Jackal Pup (2/1), Jackal Pup (2/1), Kird Ape (1/1) for 5 unblocked damage. Opponent 7→2 life. Lethal next turn.

Cast Searing Spear at opponent (3 damage). Opponent 7→4. Then attack with all 3 creatures (5 power). Baloth blocks one: deal 3+ unblocked → 1 life or less. Opponent at 1, top-deck dependent. Actually, even if blocked optimally, I'm guaranteed lethal this turn or next.
Target opponent player B. Searing Spear deals 3 damage → opponent 7→4 life. Then attack with 5 power. Win this turn or next guaranteed.
Searing Spear resolved. Opponent at 4 life. Pass to combat phase and declare attackers for lethal or near-lethal.

Searing Spear resolves. Opponent at 4 life. Pass to combat. Attack with 5 power: if Baloth blocks the 1/1 Kird Ape, I deal 4 unblocked damage for lethal. If it blocks a 2/1, I deal 3 unblocked → 1 life.
Begin Combat. Pass to Declare Attackers where I attack for lethal with 2/1, 2/1, 1/1.

Declare Attackers complete. All creatures (2/1, 2/1, 1/1) declared. Pass to blockers.
Declare Blockers phase. Pass to opponent to declare blocks.
Combat Damage phase. Opponent at 1 life with Baloth blocking one Pup. Unblocked: 2/1 Pup + 1/1 Ape = 3 damage lethal. Pass to resolve.
Combat Damage resolving. Opponent at 1 life, taking 3 unblocked damage (2/1 Pup + 1/1 Ape) = lethal. Pass to resolve.
End Combat phase. Pass to Postcombat Main. Opponent should be dead after combat damage resolution (at 1 life, took 3 unblocked).
Postcombat Main. Opponent at 1 life. Pass to End Step. Next turn attack to finish.
End Turn. Pass to opponent's turn. Opponent at 1 life, attack next turn for lethal.
Opponent's upkeep. Yield until my turn.
Opponent declare blockers. Boosted Baloth to 14/14 with growth spells (still 1 life). Yield until my next phase.
